settings.info_content:
Founded in 2022, Unmatched Kicks is an independent resale retailer specializing in authentic global streetwear, athleisure, and limited-edition sneakers.

We source premium products from verified secondary market suppliers and trusted sellers, making exclusive international releases accessible to customers across India.
OUR MISSION

Our mission is simple — to bring authentic global streetwear and performance wear to India with transparency, reliability, and trust.

We aim to bridge the gap between international drops and Indian consumers by offering carefully sourced products that reflect today’s global sneaker and fitness culture.

AUTHENTICITY & QUALITY

Every product handled by Unmatched Kicks undergoes a thorough inspection process at our facility before dispatch. We examine packaging, tags, materials, and overall quality to ensure customers receive genuine products.

We do not sell counterfeit items.

OUR OPERATIONS

We operate from our registered office and warehouse facility in Mumbai, where products are received, verified, packed, and dispatched.

Orders are securely processed and shipped through trusted courier partners, with tracking provided for every shipment.

WHAT WE OFFER

We specialize in sourcing authentic products from leading international brands, including performance wear, athleisure, and sneaker culture essentials.

Our catalog includes limited-edition drops, fitness apparel, and sought-after streetwear pieces that are not always easily available in India.

CUSTOMER TRUST

Since our launch, we have served customers across India who trust us for:

✔ authenticity assurance

✔ reliable order fulfillment

✔ responsive customer support

✔ transparent communication

IMPORTANT NOTE

Unmatched Kicks operates as an independent resale retailer. We are not affiliated with, authorized by, or officially partnered with any brands featured on our platform.

All trademarks and brand names belong to their respective owners.
